# LOA_EVAL_CONTAINER_CLAUDE_BIN (default claude), LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR, LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT.
#
# Mount library: lib/sandbox-mount.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal path.
# Exported to it: ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE, ARM_ENV_FILE (meta/arm-env), LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (stub claude, stub docker, and a temporary
# copy of this harness whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is the stub mount library).
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
shopt -u patsub_replacement 2>/dev/null || true   # bash 5.2: '&' in ${x//p/r} stays literal

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
PROMPTS_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts"
# No .claude/ code is sourced (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary": the
# harness is the trusted copy and runs against a PR's .claude/).

TASK_YAML="" ARM="" RUN_DIR="" RUN_ID="" TRIAL="" SOURCE_TREE="" SUITE_FILE=""
MAX_RUN_USD="" EXECUTOR="${LOA_EVAL_EXECUTOR:-container}" IMAGE="loa-ablation:258"
CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" DOCKER_BIN="${EVAL_DOCKER_BIN:-docker}"
----
done

for v in TASK_YAML ARM RUN_ID TRIAL SOURCE_TREE SUITE_FILE; do
  [[ -n "${!v}" ]] || die_usage "missing --$(echo "$v" | tr 'A-Z_' 'a-z-')"
done
[[ "$DRY_RUN" == true || -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || die_usage "missing --run-dir"
[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || die_usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die_usage "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
[[ -d "$SOURCE_TREE" ]] || die_usage "source tree not found: $SOURCE_TREE"
[[ "$TRIAL" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die_usage "--trial must be an integer"
case "$EXECUTOR" in container|host) ;; *) die_usage "--executor must be container or host" ;; esac
for t in jq yq git timeout; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die_usage "required tool missing: $t"; done
[[ -z "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-models must be a JSON object"
[[ -z "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" || die_usage "--phase-timeouts must be a JSON object"
[[ -n "$PHASE_MODELS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_MODELS_JSON='{}'
[[ -n "$PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON" ]] || PHASE_TIMEOUTS_JSON='{}'

TASK_YAML="$(cd "$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")" && pwd)/$(basename "$TASK_YAML")"
TASK_DIR="$(dirname "$TASK_YAML")"
SUITE_ROOT="$(cd "$TASK_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_TREE="$(cd "$SOURCE_TREE" && pwd)"

TASK_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML")" || die_usage "task yaml does not parse: $TASK_YAML"
SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || die_usage "suite file does not parse: $SUITE_FILE"

if [[ -z "$MAX_RUN_USD" ]]; then
  MAX_RUN_USD="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // 12' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  cfg_cap="$(yq -r '.evals.ablation.run_cap_usd // ""' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$cfg_cap" && "$cfg_cap" != "null" ]] && MAX_RUN_USD="$cfg_cap"
fi
[[ "$MAX_RUN_USD" =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] || die_usage "--max-run-usd must be a number"
CAP_MICRO="$(jq -n --arg c "$MAX_RUN_USD" '($c|tonumber) * 1000000 | round')"

TASK_ID="$(jq -r '.id // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
TASK_TYPE="$(jq -r '.type // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TASK_ID" ]] || die_usage "task has no id"
case "$TASK_TYPE" in
  review-catch) KIND="review-catch" ;;
  bug-fix|refactor|feature-build) KIND="build" ;;
  *) die_usage "task type '$TASK_TYPE' is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" ;;
esac

OVERLAY_MODE="$(jq -r '.review_catch.overlay_mode // "head"' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
case "$OVERLAY_MODE" in head|base) ;; *) die_usage "task review_catch.overlay_mode must be head or base, got '$OVERLAY_MODE'" ;; esac

# --- arm and phase plan -------------------------------------------------------
ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$ARM" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
ALL_ARM_IDS="$(jq -r '[.arms // [] | .[] | .id] | .[]' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
REFUSAL=""
if [[ -z "$ARM_DEF" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is not declared in the suite"
elif [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == "true" ]]; then
  REFUSAL="arm '$ARM' is declared absent: true"
elif ! jq -e --arg k "$KIND" --arg t "$TASK_TYPE" \

          then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end ) as $p3

                         (if .gates == false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false", "flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .dissent == false and .gates != false then "flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled=false" else empty end),
                         (if .flatline == false then "flatline_protocol.enabled=false" else empty end) ]
                       | if length == 0 then "-" else join(",") end' <<<"$SUITE_TOGGLES")"
  fi
  printf 'sandbox: mount=%s overlay=%s config_variant=%s config_edits=%s\n' "$sb_mount" "$sb_overlay" "$sb_variant" "$sb_edits"
  [[ "$EVAL_ONLY" == true ]] && echo "eval_only: true (batch context LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1)"
  exit 0
fi

# --- run directory --------------------------------------------------------------
----
  out="$("$fn" "$@" 2>"$errf")" || rc=$?
  cat "$errf" >> "$MOUNT_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
  last="$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' "$errf" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '$p' | cut -c1-300 || true)"
  rm -f "$errf"
  [[ -n "$out" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$out" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || infra "$fn exited $rc${last:+: $last} (see meta/mount.log)"
  LIB_OUT="$out"
}

LIB_OUT=""
lib_call resolve_arm_toggles "$ARM" "$SUITE_FILE"
TOGGLES="$(printf '%s\n' "$LIB_OUT" | sed -n '/^[[:space:]]*[{]/,$p')"
if [[ -z "$TOGGLES" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$TOGGLES"; then
  infra "resolve_arm_toggles printed no toggles object"
fi
TOGGLES="$(jq -c '.' <<<"$TOGGLES")"
# the toggles object is evidence, not a key=value line: drop it from the evidence file
grep -E '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+=' "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE" > "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE.tmp" || true
mv "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE.tmp" "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
PLAN_JSON="$(plan_phases "$TOGGLES")"
LOA_MOUNT=true; [[ "$(jq -r '.loa_mount' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == false ]] && LOA_MOUNT=false
SINGLE_SESSION=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.context_resets' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == false ]] && SINGLE_SESSION=true
GATES_OFF=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.gates' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == false ]] && GATES_OFF=true
FLATLINE=on; [[ "$(jq -r '.flatline' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == false ]] && FLATLINE=off
ORACLE_OPEN=false; [[ "$(jq -r '.oracle_open' <<<"$TOGGLES")" == true ]] && ORACLE_OPEN=true
BARE_MODEL_TOGGLE="$(jq -r '.bare_model // empty' <<<"$TOGGLES")"

# --- fingerprint / image ---------------------------------------------------------
if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == host ]]; then
  command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || infra "claude CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN"
fi
FINGERPRINT="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/fingerprint.sh" --source-tree "$SOURCE_TREE" --claude-bin "$CLAUDE_BIN" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
if [[ "$EXECUTOR" == container ]]; then
  command -v "$DOCKER_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$DOCKER_BIN" ]] || infra "docker CLI not found: $DOCKER_BIN"
  IMAGE_DIGEST="$("$DOCKER_BIN" image inspect --format '{{if .RepoDigests}}{{index .RepoDigests 0}}{{else}}{{.Id}}{{end}}' "$IMAGE" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$IMAGE_DIGEST" ]] || infra "container image not found: $IMAGE"
else
  IMAGE_DIGEST="$FINGERPRINT"
fi

# --- materialisation (D-4.5) -------------------------------------------------------
resolve_rel() {  # resolve_rel <relpath> → first existing dir among the candidate roots
  local rel="$1" c
  if [[ "$rel" == /* ]]; then [[ -d "$rel" ]] && { printf '%s' "$rel"; return 0; }; return 1; fi
  for c in "$TASK_DIR/$rel" "$SUITE_ROOT/$rel" "$REPO_ROOT/$rel" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rel" "$SOURCE_TREE/evals/fixtures/$rel"; do
    [[ -d "$c" ]] && { (cd "$c" && pwd); return 0; }
  done
  return 1
}
sgit() {  # git on the sandbox repo, isolated from the operator's git config
  env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$META" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 LC_ALL=C \
    git -C "$WS" "$@"
}

if [[ "$KIND" == build ]]; then
  fx_rel="$(jq -r '.fixture // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$fx_rel" ]] || infra "build task has no fixture"
  FIXTURE_DIR="$(resolve_rel "$fx_rel")" || infra "fixture not found: $fx_rel"
  case "/$FIXTURE_DIR/" in */hidden/*) infra "fixture resolves inside a hidden directory: $fx_rel" ;; esac
  lib_call check_fixture_path_rule "$FIXTURE_DIR"
  cp -a "$FIXTURE_DIR/." "$WS/"

     4	# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
     5	# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
     6	# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
     7	# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
     8	#
     9	# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
    10	# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
    11	# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
    12	# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
    13	# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
    14	# task_types against the known types).
    15	#
    16	# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
    17	#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
    18	#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
    19	# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
    20	#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
    21	#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
    22	# toggles (the vocabulary apply_arm_toggles and pipeline-run.sh accept; every value is
    23	#   `false` except where named): companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files,
    24	#   audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount, gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets,
    25	#   effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max, and from cycle-131 (FR-5, DEC-0619)
    26	#   bare_model: fable (BARE on Fable 5.1), dissent: false (the review gate's
    27	#   adversarial dissent off in the sandbox config; the audit gate unchanged),
    28	#   oracle_open: true (eval-only: the closed-mount overlay skipped, mount_overlay=none).
    29	#   Every mounted review-catch arm runs the closed mount (lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    30	#   overlay_answer_paths, head mode unless the task sets review_catch.overlay_mode: base)
    31	#   and every mounted arm the eval config variant (config_variant=eval).
    32	# eval_only: true|false (cycle-131 FR-5; default false): an evaluation-only arm. pipeline-run.sh
    33	#   refuses it (exit 2) unless LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1, which run-ablation.sh exports to every
    34	#   trial it launches; validate-suite.sh requires it on an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true.
    35	# =============================================================================
    36	name: ablation-2.0
    37	version: 1
    38	source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
    39	agy_opt_in: false
    40	tasks:
    41	  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
    42	  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
    43	  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
    44	suite_version: 2   # suite v2 (DEC-0559, DEC-0566): twelve harder build tasks with v2 ids; the four review-catch tasks unchanged in content
    45	trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
    46	cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
    47	# Per-run caps (DEC-0559, DEC-0567): from Sprint 261 the cap is per task kind,
    48	# run_usd_by_type {build: 15, review-catch: 20}; run-ablation.sh passes the kind's cap to
    49	# pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd, charges a cap failure or a costless failed trial that
    50	# kind's cap, and reserves in-flight trials at the largest cap among the plan's kinds.
    51	# run_usd stays the single-cap fallback (suite v1 batches, a kind without an entry) and
    52	# --run-cap overrides both kinds. reserve_usd is kept for spend.sh; DEC-0559 released the
    53	# reserve (a batch's --max-usd = 1,500 - spend so far - concurrency x the largest cap).
    54	caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250, run_usd_by_type: {build: 15, review-catch: 20}}
    55	priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
    56	cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)
    57	
    58	# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
    59	# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
    60	phase_defaults:
    61	  models:
    62	    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    63	    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    64	    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    65	    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    66	    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    67	    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    68	  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
    69	  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
    70	  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
    71	  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
    72	  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
    73	phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
    74	  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
    75	  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]
    76	
    77	arms:
    78	  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
    79	     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
    80	  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}   # oracle_closed: cycle-131 FR-1 (DEC-0615); review-catch runs only, a build run passes it vacuously
    81	  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
    82	     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
    83	     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    84	  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
    85	  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
    86	     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
    87	     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
    88	  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
    89	     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    90	  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
    91	     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
    92	  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
    93	     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
    94	  # cycle-131 FR-5 (DEC-0619, SDD §3.2 "Entity: suite arm"): review-catch only. a0_bare_fable is A0 on the
    95	  # review model; a1_review_only drops the AUDIT gate; a1_no_dissent turns the review gate's dissent off;
    96	  # a1_full_openmount is the cycle-130 open mount, eval_only (pipeline-run.sh refuses it outside a
    97	  # run-ablation.sh batch or smoke: LOA_ABLATION_BATCH_CONTEXT=1) and never a decision arm
    98	  - {id: a0_bare_fable, label: A0F, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {loa_mount: false, bare_model: fable}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
    99	     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, bare_model_fable, integrity_clean]}
   100	  - {id: a1_review_only, label: A1R, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {}, phases: [REVIEW],
   101	     took_effect: [review_only_phases, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}
   102	  - {id: a1_no_dissent, label: A1N, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {dissent: false},
   103	     took_effect: [all_phases_present, no_review_dissent_envelope, oracle_closed, integrity_clean]}
   104	  - {id: a1_full_openmount, label: A1O, task_types: [review-catch], toggles: {oracle_open: true}, eval_only: true,
   105	     took_effect: [all_phases_present, oracle_open_recorded, integrity_clean]}
   106	  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
   107	     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}
   108	
   109	rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
   110	  threshold_points: 0.03
   111	  cost_lower_pct: 15
   112	  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
   113	  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
   114	  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
   115	  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
   116	  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
   117	  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
   118	  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
   119	  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
   120	  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
   121	  predicates:                                # DEC-0416, DEC-0393, DEC-0530; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %; evaluated in this order
   122	    inconclusive_by_degradation: "the arm's excluded share > 0.25 (whatever its interval; DEC-0393)"
   123	    investigate: "else any applicable primary has lo > 0"
   124	    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
   125	    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or no valid pair"
   126	    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
   127	    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
   128	  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
   129	  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
   130	  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
   131	  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
   132	  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
   133	  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?, churn?} (churn: {files, insertions,
    21	#      deletions}, non-negative integers; Sprint 259), post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    22	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    23	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    24	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    25	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    26	#      relative paths present in the fixture; for build types it lists every file
    27	#      under fixture/tests/, Sprint 259), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    28	#      refactor: regression_command must be null — test_command is the regression check),
    29	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    30	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    31	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    32	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    33	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    34	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    35	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    36	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    37	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    38	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    39	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    40	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    41	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    42	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    43	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    44	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    45	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    46	#   8. suite file arms (cycle-131 FR-5): `toggles` is a mapping whose every key is in
    47	#      the vocabulary of lib/sandbox-mount.sh apply_arm_toggles with a value it defines
    48	#      (companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files, audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount,
    49	#      gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets, dissent: false; effort:
    50	#      low|medium|high|xhigh|max; bare_model: fable; oracle_open: true); `took_effect`
    51	#      is a list whose every id is a rule took-effect.sh defines (its `rule_<id>()`
    52	#      functions, read from the script beside this one); `eval_only`, when present, is
    53	#      a boolean; an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true carries eval_only: true
    54	#
    55	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    57	# =============================================================================
    58	set -euo pipefail
    59	export LC_ALL=C
    60	
    61	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    62	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
45a46,53
> #   8. suite file arms (cycle-131 FR-5): `toggles` is a mapping whose every key is in
> #      the vocabulary of lib/sandbox-mount.sh apply_arm_toggles with a value it defines
> #      (companion_voice, karpathy_block, rule_files, audit_delta_instruction, loa_mount,
> #      gates, flatline, sprint_plan, context_resets, dissent: false; effort:
> #      low|medium|high|xhigh|max; bare_model: fable; oracle_open: true); `took_effect`
> #      is a list whose every id is a rule took-effect.sh defines (its `rule_<id>()`
> #      functions, read from the script beside this one); `eval_only`, when present, is
> #      a boolean; an arm whose toggles set oracle_open: true carries eval_only: true
53,60d60
< SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
< REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
< ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
< SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
< PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
< SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
< 
< usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,47p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }

# version (or none) is present, such rows join it. Every row passes the manifest arm_map provenance
# check (DEC-0407, exit 2) before any partition or listing decision, a version-less row included (1.2.2).
# Version keys (report 1.2.1): an integer-valued number or numeric string keys to the integer ("2",
# 2, 2.0 and "2.0" are one version "2"); another finite number keys to its shortest round-trip form
# (2.1 and "2.10" → "2.1"); another string keys to itself, stripped; absent = null, a boolean, an
# empty or blank string, or a non-number non-string. --suite-version is keyed by the same rule.
# Numeric keys sort numerically, every other key after them, lexically; the primary is the last.
# JSON primary_suite_version is an int for an integer key, a float for another numeric key. Since 1.2.2 every
# JSON version value has that type: primary_suite_version, by_suite_version[N].suite_version, h1/a4
# .suite_version (top level, per version, sensitivity), budget_matched.suite_version and
# batches[].suite_version (a string for a non-numeric key or a "1, 2" list, null for n/a); the
# by_suite_version object keys stay strings.
# JSON: primary_suite_version and by_suite_version {"N": {suite_version, rows, batches,
# suite_manifest_sha256, decidable, h1, a4, decisions, arms, exclusions, listed, cap_failures}};
# the top-level keys describe the primary version.
#
# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
#
# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
#                   ids when present and consistent, else each defect of the task takes the row's
#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows; report 1.2.3: a list with an id outside
#                   d1 … dN of the task, a duplicate id, or N − len(ids) ≠ a numeric defects_caught
#                   is inconsistent and reads as the rate, "rate" in defect_identity, never
#                   "ids"; the row writer 1.3 rules); the task-level figure is also
#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
#                   cells the primaries paired
#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
#
# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an
#   applicable primary exceeds rules.mde_cut and whose predicate outcome is remove or
#   simplify reads Inconclusive-by-power with the figure (a null result the sample could
#   not have detected); A8 (absent: true) reads component-absent with the suite evidence.
#
# H1 and A4 lines (Sprint 262): each comparison is read, first match: not_testable (no task of
#   the primary's types in either arm: "<metric>: not testable on suite_version N — no
#   admissible task") → inconclusive_by_degradation (either arm's excluded share over its cells
#   on that primary's task types > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share) → degenerate (a
#   defect_catch_rate comparison whose pairs come from one task and whose rows carry no
#   per-defect ids: the interval is zero-variance by construction; flagged degenerate: true with
#   degenerate_reason and read as no valid pair, also by the component decisions) → no_pair →
#   tested. H1: established (a tested primary with lo > 0) | not established — halt before
#   promotion (a tested primary, none with lo > 0) | inconclusive by degradation — not
#   established (every testable primary inconclusive by degradation) | not yet decidable (no
#   pair). A4: holds | fails — harden tasks … | inconclusive by degradation (…) — not decided |
#   not testable on suite_version N — no admissible build task | not yet decidable (no pair).
    if m is None:
        return
    amap = m.get("arm_map") or {}
    if isinstance(amap, dict) and row["run_id"] in amap and amap[row["run_id"]] != row["arm"]:
        raise Fail(f"{row['_where']}: row {row['run_id']} arm {row['arm']} disagrees with "
                   f"{m['_path']} arm_map ({amap[row['run_id']]})")


def list_reason(row, mans, arms):
    """Why a row is listed and never decided, or None when it enters a cell (the first checks of
    Analysis._classify, after provenance_check); partition() reuses it (report 1.2.1)."""
    m = mans.get(row.get("batch"))
    if m is None:
        return "no manifest for batch " + str(row.get("batch"))
    if m.get("smoke") is True:
        return "smoke batch " + str(row.get("batch"))
    arm, ttype = row.get("arm"), row.get("task_type")
    if arm not in arms or arms[arm].get("absent"):
        return f"arm {arm} is not run by the suite"
    if ttype not in BUILD_TYPES and ttype != REVIEW:
        return f"unknown task_type {ttype}"
    if not applies_to(arms[arm], ttype):
        return f"not applicable: {arm} does not run {ttype} tasks"
    return None


PART_VERSION = {}   # report 1.3: partition key -> its suite_version key (a key differs from it when split)


def part_rule(r):
    """the grader rule a row's catch figures follow: grader_rule, "pm3" for a review-catch row without one
    (a 1.2.x grade), None for a build row (no catch figure)"""
    if r.get("task_type") != REVIEW:
        return None
    v = r.get("grader_rule")
    return v if isinstance(v, str) and v else "pm3"
        if not PIN_GRAMMAR.fullmatch(pin):

        kept = [r for r in rows if str(r.get("source_commit") or "").lower().startswith(pin)]
        pin_dropped = len(rows) - len(kept)
        if not kept:
            raise Fail(f"--pin {args.pin}: no row has a source_commit starting with it")
        rows = kept
    mans = load_manifests(args.manifests)
    arms = [a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")]
    arm_ids = [a["id"] for a in arms]
    labels = {str(a.get("label", a["id"])).upper(): a["id"] for a in arms}
    cuts = load_cuts(args.cuts, args.not_run, set(arm_ids), labels)
    for need in (CONTROL, BARE):
        if need not in arm_ids:

    # components: every runnable arm but the two baselines; an eval_only arm (cycle-131 FR-5: the open-mount
    # oracle A/B) is an evaluation control, never a shipped-default decision, so it is not a component here
    components = [a["id"] for a in arms if a["id"] not in (CONTROL, BARE) and not a.get("absent") and a.get("eval_only") is not True]
    absent = [a for a in arms if a.get("absent")]

    versions = sorted(groups, key=part_order(groups), reverse=True)
    others = [v for v in versions if v != primary]

@test "closed mount (real library): the overlaid gate script runs at the PR's version, the evidence is on disk before the first phase, and took-effect oracle_closed passes on the run" {
  # the real mount library at the literal path; a source tree whose pinned gate script is LATER than the PR
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh" "$H/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/took-effect.sh" "$H/"
  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
  printf 'gate head\n' > "$T/src/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm head )
  local hc; hc="$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)"
  printf 'gate LATER fixed\n' > "$T/src/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm fix )
  local p="$T/prs/pr-y" r="$T/suite/tasks/rc-02"
  mkdir -p "$p/base/.claude/scripts" "$p/head/.claude/scripts" "$r"
  printf 'gate base\n' > "$p/base/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"; printf 'gate head\n' > "$p/head/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"
  printf 'diff --git a/.claude/scripts/gate.sh b/.claude/scripts/gate.sh\n--- a/.claude/scripts/gate.sh\n+++ b/.claude/scripts/gate.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-gate base\n+gate head\n' > "$p/head.diff"
  printf '# PR\n' > "$p/PR.md"
  printf 'name: pr-y\nhead_commit: "%s"\nfix_commit: "%s"\n' "$hc" "$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)" > "$p/fixture.yaml"
  printf 'Review the pull request in pr/.\n' > "$r/TASK.md"
  printf 'id: rc-02\nschema_version: 1\ntype: review-catch\ncriterion: "review the change"\nreview_catch: {fixture: "%s"}\n' "$p" > "$r/task.yaml"
  # the CLI wrapper snapshots the evidence file and the gate script at the first phase launch
  cat > "$T/claude-ev" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [[ "\${1:-}" == -p ]]; then   # a phase launch (fingerprint.sh calls --version first)
  [[ -e "$T/log/evidence-at-first-phase.txt" ]] || cp "$T/run/meta/arm-evidence.txt" "$T/log/evidence-at-first-phase.txt"
  [[ -e "$T/log/gate-at-first-phase.txt" ]] || cp "$T/run/sandbox/.claude/scripts/gate.sh" "$T/log/gate-at-first-phase.txt"
fi
exec "$T/claude" "\$@"
EOF
  chmod +x "$T/claude-ev"
  export LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN="$T/no-br"
  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$r/task.yaml" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r-rl --trial 1 \
    --source-tree "$T/src" --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor host --claude-bin "$T/claude-ev"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; cat "$T/run/meta/mount.log"; false; }
  [ "$(cat "$T/log/gate-at-first-phase.txt")" = "gate head" ]
  local E="$T/log/evidence-at-first-phase.txt"
  grep -qx 'mount_overlay=head:1' "$E"
  grep -qx "overlay_sha256=.claude/scripts/gate.sh=$(printf 'gate head\n' | python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())')" "$E"
  grep -qx 'gate_scripts_at_pr_version=.claude/scripts/gate.sh' "$E"
  grep -qx "copy_source=$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)" "$E"
  grep -qx 'config_variant=eval' "$E"
  grep -q '^mount_closed=pre-launch head:1 answer paths (1 present), 1 later-only pinned versions' "$E"
  # the manifest is written before the closed check: the checked surface is the launched one
  [ "$(grep -n '^manifest_sha256=' "$E" | cut -d: -f1)" -lt "$(grep -n '^mount_closed=' "$E" | cut -d: -f1)" ]
  cp "$T/suite.yaml" "$T/suite-oc.yaml"
  yq -i '(.arms[] | select(.id == "a1_full") | .took_effect) += ["oracle_closed"]' "$T/suite-oc.yaml"
  run "$H/took-effect.sh" --run-dir "$T/run" --suite-file "$T/suite-oc.yaml" --task-yaml "$r/task.yaml"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; false; }
  grep -q 'oracle_closed OK ok head:1 answer paths (1 present)' <<<"$output"
}

@test "closed mount (real library): the overlaid gate script runs at the PR's version, the evidence is on disk before the first phase, and took-effect oracle_closed passes on the run" {
  # the real mount library at the literal path; a source tree whose pinned gate script is LATER than the PR
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh" "$H/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/took-effect.sh" "$H/"
  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
  printf 'gate head\n' > "$T/src/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm head )
  local hc; hc="$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)"
  printf 'gate LATER fixed\n' > "$T/src/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm fix )
  local p="$T/prs/pr-y" r="$T/suite/tasks/rc-02"
  mkdir -p "$p/base/.claude/scripts" "$p/head/.claude/scripts" "$r"
  printf 'gate base\n' > "$p/base/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"; printf 'gate head\n' > "$p/head/.claude/scripts/gate.sh"
  printf 'diff --git a/.claude/scripts/gate.sh b/.claude/scripts/gate.sh\n--- a/.claude/scripts/gate.sh\n+++ b/.claude/scripts/gate.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-gate base\n+gate head\n' > "$p/head.diff"
  printf '# PR\n' > "$p/PR.md"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [[ "\${1:-}" == -p ]]; then   # a phase launch (fingerprint.sh calls --version first)

fi
exec "$T/claude" "\$@"
EOF

  grep -qx 'gate_scripts_at_pr_version=.claude/scripts/gate.sh' "$E"

  grep -q '^mount_closed=pre-launch head:1 answer paths (1 present), 1 later-only pinned versions' "$E"

  [ "$(grep -n '^manifest_sha256=' "$E" | cut -d: -f1)" -lt "$(grep -n '^mount_closed=' "$E" | cut -d: -f1)" ]

  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; false; }

}

head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — Excluding eval_only arms from `components` also drops them from `detail_arms` (line 2003), but `list_reason` (line 1117) still admits their rows, since the arm is declared and not absent. So a1_full_openmount rows go into the analysis and then show up nowhere: no decision, no per-arm detail, not listed. The open-mount oracle A/B that FR-5 adds this arm for disappears from the report without any notice. The arm needs its own reported section, or its rows need to be listed with a reason.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1913 — The filter still counts a0_bare_fable, a1_review_only and a1_no_dissent as components. a0_bare_fable is a baseline (A0 on the review model), not a component, yet it now gets a keep/remove/simplify decision against a1_full as if it were a shipped default. The pre-registered component count also grows from 6 to 9. That changes the expected-false-positive figure after registration, while the rules block (suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117) and this script's header (line 8: "every component arm (A2 … A7)") still say 6 / A2…A7.
head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1930 — Switching the expected-false-positive sentence from `.1f` to `.2f` changes the wording of every existing report (0.3/0.6 → 0.30/0.60). Re-rendering a cycle-130 report no longer gives the same pre-registered sentence. The change is only there to fit k=9; a format that keeps the old k=6 text would be safer.
head/evals/tests/ablation-report.bats:342 — The test now expects suite_version 1 to have 9 decisions. Three of them are arms (a0_bare_fable, a1_review_only, a1_no_dissent) that never existed under suite v1. The report gives them phantom "no valid pair" decision rows in the v1 section, and this test locks that regression in instead of catching it.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:117 — The pre-registered rules comment still says "expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed", but the report now prints 9. The pre-registration and the analysis disagree, and the arms were added to a frozen suite with no suite version bump or pre-registration note.
head/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:41 — Scope gap: the PR title promises "the cycle-131 suite root (bounds 50/40) with its image self-check", but no file in the diff adds a cycle-131 suite root, bounds of 50/40, or an image self-check. tasks.root/smoke_root still point at the cycle-130 ablation-2.0 root, and RAB-c131-5 copies that same root. Either deliver these parts or take them out of the title.
head/evals/harness/validate-suite.sh:137 — TOGGLE_VALUES is a hard-coded copy of the apply_arm_toggles vocabulary, while the header (line 47) says the check follows lib/sandbox-mount.sh, and RULE_IDS is read from took-effect.sh. A toggle added to the library will be rejected as unknown, and a toggle removed from it will still pass, until someone edits this table by hand.
head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:342 — The dry run's `config_edits` re-implements apply_arm_toggles' config edits from the raw suite toggles (SUITE_TOGGLES), not from the toggles the library resolves (TOGGLES, line 519). The dry-run plan can therefore drift from what a real run writes into the sandbox .loa.config.yaml, and no test checks that the two agree.
head/evals/tests/run-ablation.bats:1189 — The test title says "the runner's own environment is unchanged", but the only assertion (line 1190) checks the test shell before run-ablation.sh starts. Nothing checks that the variable stays scoped to the trial command inside the runner, for example that grade or took-effect children don't get it.
